summary: The note covers the office of Governor of New Jersey, naming the first governor and the current governor. It states that William Livingston served first, from August 31, 1776, to July 25, 1790. It also states that Phil Murphy took office on January 16, 2018, with his term ending in January 2022.
one_line: Overview of the Governor of New Jersey office, listing first governor William Livingston and current governor Phil Murphy.
key_facts: The first Governor of New Jersey was William Livingston.
William Livingston served as Governor of New Jersey from August 31, 1776, to July 25, 1790.
The current Governor of New Jersey is Phil Murphy.
Phil Murphy assumed office as Governor of New Jersey on January 16, 2018.
Phil Murphy's term as Governor of New Jersey ends in January 2022.
